headline: Share prefix paths, mark complete words
statement: Implement Trie with insert(word), search(word), and startsWith(prefix). search requires an inserted whole word; startsWith accepts a prefix of an inserted word. Supply parallel operations and args arrays, beginning with Trie and empty constructor args.
intuition: Each character is one edge in a shared prefix tree. A terminal marker distinguishes an inserted word from a path created only because a longer word was inserted.
approach: Create character-keyed child dictionaries on insertion.
Mark the final dictionary with a non-letter terminal key.
Follow query characters; whole-word search requires the marker, while prefix search only requires the path.
correctness: Insertion creates exactly the path spelling its word and marks exactly its endpoint. A reachable query path corresponds to an inserted word prefix. The terminal marker exists exactly when that full query was inserted.
bruteForce: Store words in a set and scan all of them on each prefix query; this repeatedly compares shared prefixes.

complexity.explanation: A method follows one edge per character; shared prefixes reuse nodes.

pitfalls: Inserting apple does not make search(app) true.
Terminal keys must not overlap valid letters.
Repeated insertion should leave the tree unchanged.
